t: Pipulate's Two Realms: State Persistence in Notebooks vs. Nix
s: Pipulate achieves state persistence in Jupyter Notebooks (like Google Colab) by dynamically determining database location: 'data/pipulate_dev.db' in dev environments (detecting 'flake.nix') or '~/.pipulate/pipulate.db' when installed via pip. This allows stateful workflows and resume capabilities even after kernel restarts.
sub: Dynamic database path determination based on environment (flake.nix presence)
Pipulate's role in enabling resumable workflows in ephemeral environments
Comparison of state management in Notebooks vs. Nix-based development
